name: MiniMax H3 ControlNet (pose) — transfer a person's movement + audio
description:
Upload a video of someone moving (a dance, gestures, a sports move) and describe who should perform it and where. The people in the clip are detected and a full-body skeleton (body, hands, face, feet) is tracked on every frame; MiniMax H3 then generates a brand-new video where your described character performs exactly those movements, with a matching audio track. Clothing, face, background and lighting all come from your prompt.

The people must be clearly visible — ideally the whole body, not too small in the frame. Without a detectable person the pose is guessed and the movement is not followed. "Max people to track" sets how many dancers are followed; "Control strength" sets how strictly the pose is copied (1 = exactly, lower = looser).

Only the first seconds of your clip are used ("Duration", default 5 s), and the video is centre-cropped to the aspect ratio you pick. Pose tracking adds a little time on top of the render; "Fast mode" (4-step turbo LoRA) is several times faster at some cost in quality.

promptGuides.label: MiniMax H3 reference-mode prompt guide — MiniMax
promptGuides.tip: Describe the new look — characters, materials, setting, lighting — and the soundscape; the movement comes from your video. Every detail should be something you can see or hear.

promptGuides.label: H3 prompt tips for ComfyUI — Comfy-Org

exposedParameters.label: Source video (a person moving - dance, gestures, sport)
Prompt (new character / scene / camera / sound)
exposedParameters.default:
Scene: Hyperreal desert-storm aesthetic. A humanoid figure made of packed sand dances in a barren wasteland, each move shedding dust, the wind eroding and reshaping its body.
[0s-2s] Pale desert, a sand humanoid begins to move from stillness, surface grains trickling off and dragging mist-like trails in the wind.
[2s-4s] Spins and arm swings keep dissolving and rebuilding its edges, raised sand columns glowing gold in hard light under a searing white sky.
[4s-5s] On the final pose, half the body has already been carried away by wind as a hanging line of sand, not yet fallen.
Camera: medium fixed shot, focus pull from sand-grain close-up to full body.
Audio: fine sand-scrape texture throughout, one distant desert wind call at 2s, no music.
Negative: no dissolve transitions / no text overlays / no human face / no camera shake

exposedParameters.label: Aspect ratio (pick the one closest to your video)
Control strength (1 = follow the video closely, lower = looser)
